text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Former Romanian tennis star Ilie Nastase plans to create a new centrist party and run for the president job in 2000, the paper quotes a French publication as saying.
- Temperatures reached record low of minus 33 degrees Celsius in north-east Romania.
- Report on commemoration of 49 years since Romania's ex-king Michael was forced in exile by the former communists.
- Romania has chances to join NATO, said political analyst Jonathan Eyal from the Royal Institute for Strategic Studies in London.
- Report on blizzards and snowstorsm which hit Romania over the past days.
- 45 homeless people died because of the cold weather in Bucharest over the past five days, the paper said.
